name: Tall Grass
want: keep his people fed and at peace, and the Wind River valley theirs
secret: He has privately told Washakie he would rather fight than sign away the Wind River, and fears the young men will learn it and act on it.
voice: Slow, careful speech; stories before decisions.
description: Leads a family band among Washakie's Eastern Shoshone, respected for his generosity and his caution with the Americans.
appearance: Grey braids wrapped in otter fur, a trade blanket, a peace medal he rarely wears.
